name: ci-watch
description: /ci-watch follows your GitHub Actions run and tells you the moment it passes or fails.

pollSec.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSec.description: How often to ask GitHub for the run's status (minimum 10).

autoFix.title: Investigate failures
autoFix.description: When CI fails, ask Claude to read the failed logs and fix the cause.

sound.title: Play a sound
sound.description: Play a chime when the run passes and a low tone when it fails.
